body: The roll call is fixed. The assembly preserves the generated field words. The host attaches exactly the authorized source IDs to each bounded field. A supplied conflicting ID fails the format check.
release: Every selected generation ends, the aggregate is at most 185 words, all IDs agree with the packet, and the material guard is clear.
completeness: Report complete documentary criteria separately from release. Partial facts earn no full compound criterion.
comparison: Freeze both prompts, source cards, output ceilings and criteria before generation. Score all first-pass outputs. The comparison gets the same abstracted proposition in both formats.
